text:
Yes. Hansen Global Forest Change detected **0.7 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2020**, about 0.02% of the property. The JRC 2020 forest reference mapped the entire event area as forest, and a later year was observed, satisfying the tool’s corroboration rule.

The 2021 MGAP map classified 0.4 hectares of the event area as planted pine forest and 0.3 hectares as outside mapped forest; none was mapped as native forest.

An additional 1.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares, so it was not counted as an event.
